selfHosted: HTTP(S) instance origin with optional reverse-proxy path prefix

excluded.reason: Signed storage form transfer, not a Plane API endpoint

validation.liveVerification: Disposable-project HTTP checks exercise v2 and v1 compatibility on Plane Cloud. A real signed webhook delivery exercises registration, signature verification, filtering and cleanup. Community Edition is source-audited; no separate self-hosted server was live-tested.

documentedLimitations: Advanced endpoints depend on the Plane edition and version. Community Edition uses v1.
Signed object-storage transfers are performed with the returned upload URL and form fields; asset initialization and confirmation are exposed as Plane actions.
Expanded v2 objects without a published nested schema are preserved as JSON rather than assigning guessed fields.
The knowledge connector uses v1 to access description content, which v2 work-item reads omit. Offset listings disable automatic deletion reconciliation.
Project-filtered v1 deletions without project information are skipped.

Plane v2 can retain deleted label and assignee IDs in read responses. The update action clears through v1 when necessary, verifies that state, and returns the verified cleared relationships. Use v1 for active relationship reads after clearing.
v1 membership removals are sequential and can partially commit if a later request fails; the action reports failure with the completed removal count.
